xenforo.thread_title: Cyber Recovery Part 2: How Do You Find a Recovery Point You Can Trust?
xenforo.message:
Part 2 of the VCF Insider cyber recovery series is now live.

The newest recovery point is not automatically the safest one. The initial compromise may predate detection by days or weeks, which means recent snapshots and backups can preserve the same malicious foothold you are trying to remove.

This article covers:

[LIST]
[*]Why compromise timing changes recovery-point selection
[*]How retention depth affects your available choices
[*]Why candidate recovery points should be validated in isolation
[*]Why a supported security inspection control is essential before returning workloads to production
[*]What to do when a candidate recovery point is found to be compromised
[/LIST]

Read the article:
[URL]{{ARTICLE_URL}}[/URL]

How does your organization decide how far back to investigate after a cyber incident? What evidence must a recovery point provide before you trust it enough to return to production?
